items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: and Sol Tenenbaum says, "This Monday and Tuesday, the Wilbur Ware Trio!"

ctx.x: That following Wednesday, that following week. And Sol said, "Well, you know, you're the house rhythm section" -- so that meant we had to play behind Thelonious.
So, Jody was off, so they all said, "Well, who are we gonna get?" So Wilbur Wilt said, "Well, let's get Griffin." And I said, "Good idea!" the following week So I remember Griff came in ...
